title: Free Guy
desc: When Guy, a bank teller, learns that he is a non-player character in a bloodthirsty, open-world video game, he goes on to become the hero of the story and takes the responsibility of saving the world.

title: Baby Driver
desc: A gifted getaway driver with hearing impairment works for a ruthless crime boss, seeks freedom with his girlfriend, but is dragged into a dangerous final score.

desc: Scrat causes a monumental disaster when his nut chasing leads to a continental drift. Once again, Manny, Diego and Sid experience an adventure while trying to return home.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
desc: Shang-Chi, a martial artist, lives a quiet life after he leaves his father and the shadowy Ten Rings organisation behind. Years later, he is forced to confront his past when the Ten Rings attack him.

title: The Last Airbender
desc: Follows the adventures of Aang, a young successor to a long line of Avatars, who must master all four elements and stop the Fire Nation.

title: Spider-Man
desc: Tobey Maguire dons the mask of Spider-Man, in a superhero epic that sees him struggle with the responsibilities and sacrifices that come with power.

title: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
desc: The director of night-time operations at the museum and his heroic friends travel to London in order to save the magic that brings the museum exhibits to life.
